integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, naturalistic wildlife documentary style, a medium-wide shot frames an adult black-crested gibbon with sleek black fur perched on a slender high branch in a dense tropical rainforest canopy, soft dappled morning light filtering through layered emerald leaves. The gibbon, agile and light in build, stretches its remarkably long, slender arms gracefully between the treetops, then lifts its head and emits a high, soaring, prolonged call — the unmistakable rising cry characteristic of the Hainan black-crested gibbon — echoing across the forest. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the shot cuts to a tracking view as the gibbon launches into motion, swinging and leaping with fluid, acrobatic grace along hanging vines and crisscrossing branches, each movement light and vigorous, brachiating through the green depths. Between swings it calls again, the special melodic cry carrying through the canopy — a courtship song expressing affection toward an unseen beloved. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a distant treetop where a second gibbon answers the call with its own resonant cry, the two voices weaving together through the forest. The first gibbon pauses, alert and hopeful, then springs toward the answering sound. [Shot 4] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a wide tracking shot as the two gibbons meet and glide side by side, sweeping in graceful arcs across the layered emerald canopy, moving together through the vast, rolling waves of forest. The camera follows them smoothly and restrained as their silhouettes cross the endless green treetops — a tender, moving romance within wild, untamed nature.

overall_soundscape: High, long gibbon calls echo and answer each other across the canopy, layered over rustling leaves, swaying and creaking branches, and the soft whoosh of bodies swinging through air. Distant tropical birdsong drifts beneath the forest ambience.
